**Established:** 60 cm reflector (2017), 20 cm refractor for outreach. ~195 useful nights/year; 168 in 2024 (wet autumn). ~400 GB/month, nightly 40-min transfer to Marseille university server.

**Decided:** No runs during outreach evenings (2023 incident). Raw frames never deleted, compressed after two years. Acquisition software changes need a test night.

**Failed/fixed:** 2023 dome motor seized; telescope hit dome wall, counterweight rod bent; rod replaced, limit switch added. Feb 2025: 1.2 s timestamp offset lost three weeks of photometry; now GPS-checked each session.

**Planned:** New camera (March 2025, 30% lower read noise) needs firmware update, one offline night.

**Open:** Spanish collaboration scheduling tool unevaluated; network capacity for simultaneous transfers unknown.
